newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: ZIMBABWE MONEY MARKET RATES MIXED IN QUIET TRADE.
newsitem.headline: ZIMBABWE MONEY MARKET RATES MIXED IN QUIET TRADE.

text.p: Short-term interest rates on Zimbabwe's money market were quoted mixed in quiet trade on Monday.

The market opened with a slight surplus of Z$2 million and the central Reserve Bank, forecasting a further injection of Z$431 million from maturities, auctioned Z$44 million worth of 91-day treasury bills at 24.86 percent.
Treasury bills were also trading on the secondary market at 24.75 percent, while call money was firmer at 22 percent from Friday's 18 percent.

NCDs maturing after 30, 60 and 90 days were being bought at 26 percent from 25.75 and sold at 25.5 from 25 percent while bankers acceptances eased to 25 percent from 25.75 percent (buying) but were unchanged at 24.75 on the selling side.
